Refund Policy

Effective Date: January 1, 2025

1. Subscription Plans

All monthly subscription plans (Basic Guardian, Complete Care, Dementia Support) are billed on a monthly basis.

2. Cancellation

  • No lock-in period: You may cancel your subscription at any time
  • Notice: Please provide at least 7 days notice before your next billing cycle
  • How to cancel: Send a WhatsApp message to +91 72888 18181 or email hello@kolkataeldercare.in

3. Refund Eligibility

ScenarioRefund
Cancel within 48 hours of first paymentFull refund
Cancel within first week (no services used)Full refund
Cancel mid-month (services partially used)Pro-rated refund
Cancel after full month of serviceNo refund (next month not charged)
Service quality complaintCase-by-case review

4. Telemedicine Consultations

  • Completed consultations: Non-refundable
  • Doctor no-show or technical failure: Full refund or free rescheduling
  • Patient cancellation (24+ hours notice): Full refund
  • Patient cancellation (less than 24 hours): 50% refund
  • Patient no-show: Non-refundable

5. Refund Processing

  • UPI/Bank Transfer: 3-5 business days
  • Credit/Debit Card: 5-10 business days
  • PayPal (NRI): 5-7 business days

6. How to Request a Refund

  1. WhatsApp us at +91 72888 18181 with "REFUND REQUEST"
  2. Include your registered name and reason for refund
  3. Our team will respond within 24 hours
  4. Approved refunds are processed within the timelines above

7. Non-Refundable Services

  • Emergency coordination already dispatched
  • Medicine delivery after dispatch
  • Completed in-home visits
  • Assessment reports already generated

8. Contact

For refund queries: WhatsApp +91 72888 18181 or email hello@kolkataeldercare.in
